exposure: IADPSG diagnostic criteria for gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) criteria
International Association of the Diabetes and Pregnancy Study Groups (IADPSG) criteria
cohort: Participants from the Hyperglycemia and Adverse Pregnancy Outcomes (HAPO) study in five study centers
finding: The IADPSG criteria diagnosed more cases of GDM but demonstrated better prediction of adverse pregnancy outcomes, especially among Hispanic and Asian women.
